request:
镜头 s05：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-home48）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['consumer handheld family camera', 'low-bitrate']）：Locked look "2040s family home video" (style preset sp01-home48): a 2040s consumer handheld family camera on full auto; low-bitrate consumer digital video; fixed wide-normal zoom around 28mm equivalent at automatic, deep but soft focus; filter none; grade: warm faded beige, lifted greyish blacks, low saturation; light: available window daylight, auto-exposure pumping, highlights blooming; texture: macroblocking on motion, chroma noise in shadows, slight motion blur, focus hunting; remembered family footage: warm, soft, imperfect, held by a parent's hand.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：俯拍特写，手持轻微晃动，阳光洒在纸上。小手握着绿色蜡笔，把两个小方块用歪歪扭扭的线连起来，又连了一个。小女孩一边画一边说。环境声：蜡笔的沙沙声。
情绪：innocent, playful, quietly prophetic
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up looking down, handheld home camera with a slow slight drift
景深与虚实：Shallow focus on the crayon tip and the paper; the far edge of the drawing and the table fall soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Close-up looking down at a child's crayon drawing on a sunlit wooden table: a big black box with one red eye in the middle and many small smiling coloured boxes around it; a small child's hand holding a green crayon draws a wobbly line that joins two of the small boxes. Blocking lock: the drawing fills the frame; the big black box with the red eye sits at frame centre, the small coloured boxes around it; the child's hand enters from frame right.
Picture 2: little Nian's crayon drawing (prop reference; role: prop reference). A child's crayon drawing on a sheet of slightly crumpled paper on a wooden table in sunlight: in the middle a big black square box with one round red eye; around it many small boxes in different bright colours (yellow, blue, green, orange), each with two dot eyes and a little smile, joined to each other by wobbly crayon lines like holding hands. Naive childlike strokes, no letters or words. A few crayons beside it.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Little Nian (a six-year-old girl's high, soft, clear voice) — 小念念（6 岁小女孩的声音，稚嫩清亮）: 小的们手拉手，就不怕大的了。
现场环境声：crayon scratching on paper, faint kitchen room tone
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
